# Item locations: Pokémon Adamant Diamond

Items on the ground (item balls), hidden items and Berry patches, by area. The Dowsing Machine app on the [Pokétch](poketch.md) finds hidden items; press A on the spot to pick one up. Each item can be found once.

Berry patches: what each soft soil patch holds when a new game starts. Pick the Berries, then plant any Berry in the soil and water it with the Sprayduck from the Floaroma Town flower shop. Hidden Grottos are on [the Underground page](underground.md). Gifts from people and shops aren't listed here; the TMs are on the [TM page](tms-and-hms.md).

The items and places are the same in both versions but one: the ball at Spear Pillar holds the Adamant Orb in this version.
